version.description: A newer version is refused rather than half read. Left out, it means 1.

name.description: Importing a name that is already saved updates that server (case does not matter).

uri.description: postgres://user:password@host:port/database. Any field below, if given, wins over what the address says.

password.description: Left out of an export unless asked for. On import it goes to the Keychain, never to the saved file.

database.description: Opened first when the server is chosen.

environment.description: Shown after the name, and its colour takes the place of the indigo accent: teal for local, blue for dev, red for prod. Staging keeps the indigo. The same name may be listed once in each environment.

tunnel.description: Started before connecting if the server's port is not already answering, and stopped when the app quits. Only read from the servers file: an import ignores it, so pasted text can never make the app run a command.

oneOf.description: A program and its arguments, which needs no quoting.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the port to open.
